newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 14.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for March 14.

text.p: All Mexican ports were open Friday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
Smaller ships were warned from sailing along the coast of Tamaulipas because of dangerous winds and waves.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.
Clear skies and possible rains. Maximum winds between 10 and 15 knots (19 to 28 km/11 to 19 miles per hour) along coast.

Moderate cold front descending toward southeast at 15 knots (28 km/19 miles per hour), lowering temperatures and bringing rains to Tamaulipas, Veracruz and Yucatan coasts. Winds later in the day expected to reach 15 to 20 knots (28 to 38 km/19 to 22 miles per hour) with waves four to nine feet high.
Clear skies along rest of coast and milder winds.
Hot and partly cloudy with some rains, moderate southeastern winds from 20 to 30 km per hour.
